title: Glass Blowers, Molders, Benders, and Finishers
description: Shape molten glass according to patterns.

projection.title: Molders, shapers, and casters, except metal and plastic

tasks.text: Heat glass to pliable stage, using gas flames or ovens and rotating glass to heat it uniformly.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Heating workpieces requires physical operation

dwas.name: Heat material or workpieces to prepare for or complete production.

tasks.text: Shape, bend, or join sections of glass, using paddles, pressing and flattening hand tools, or cork.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Glass shaping is skilled manual hot work

tasks.text: Blow tubing into specified shapes to prevent glass from collapsing, using compressed air or own breath, or blow and rotate gathers in molds or on boards to obtain final shapes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Glass shaping is skilled manual hot work

tasks.text: Cut lengths of tubing to specified sizes, using files or cutting wheels.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on industrial material cutting

dwas.name: Cut industrial materials in preparation for fabrication or processing.

tasks.text: Inspect, weigh, and measure products to verify conformance to specifications, using instruments such as micrometers, calipers, magnifiers, or rulers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on dimensional measurement of workpieces

dwas.name: Weigh finished products.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

dwas.name: Measure dimensions of completed products or workpieces to verify conformance to specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Develop sketches of glass products into blueprint specifications, applying knowledge of glass technology and glass blowing.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — AI drafts blueprints; manufacturability and tolerances human

dwas.name: Create diagrams or blueprints for workpieces or products.

tasks.text: Record manufacturing information, such as quantities, sizes, or types of goods produced.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

tasks.text: Determine types and quantities of glass required to fabricate products.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Input material selection from specs; human approves

tasks.text: Design and create glass objects, using blowpipes and artisans' hand tools and equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Jewelry design needs craft and material judgment

tasks.text: Operate and maintain finishing machines to grind, drill, sand, bevel, decorate, wash, or polish glass or glass products.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Grinding requires hands-on control and feel

tasks.text: Operate electric kilns that heat and mold glass sheets to the shape and curve of metal jigs.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical control of heating/drying equipment

tasks.text: Place electrodes in tube ends and heat them with glass burners to fuse them into place.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Connecting electrical components is manual work

dwas.name: Heat material or workpieces to prepare for or complete production.

tasks.text: Strike necks of finished articles to separate articles from blowpipes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual trimming of workpieces

tasks.text: Place rubber hoses on ends of tubing and charge tubing with gas.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mounting workpieces is physical loading

dwas.name: Mount materials or workpieces onto production equipment.

tasks.text: Place glass into dies or molds of presses and control presses to form products, such as glassware components or optical blanks.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual placement of materials into molds

tasks.text: Repair broken scrolls by replacing them with new sections of tubing.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on removal and fitting of worn components

tasks.text: Spray or swab molds with oil solutions to prevent adhesion of glass.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Applying parting agents is manual mold prep

dwas.name: Apply parting agents or other solutions to molds.

tasks.text: Superimpose bent tubing on asbestos patterns to ensure accuracy.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Drawing guide lines on materials is hands-on

dwas.name: Draw guide lines or markings on materials or workpieces using patterns or other references.

tasks.text: Set up and adjust machine press stroke lengths and pressures and regulate oven temperatures, according to glass types to be processed.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual temperature control adjustment

dwas.name: Adjust temperature controls of ovens or other heating equipment.

emerging_tasks.task: Apply surface decorations, such as colored glass, enamels, and lusters.
